scientific_integrity: The infinite-time and real-order statements are justified analytically by a positive homogeneous eigen-energy. Exact finite-path and numerical tests only corroborate the proof; no external certification is represented.
scientific_limitations: Two-dimensional real switching matrices, with nonzero nilpotent successful update and nontrivial unipotent erased-step update.
I.i.d. Bernoulli transmission success and zero control on erasure; additive disturbances and hold-last-input protocols are not addressed.
All positive finite real moment orders are covered at deterministic iteration times; endpoints of the erasure probability are not included.
Explicit Euclidean comparison constants are constructive but not optimized; exact moment rate is defined implicitly by a convergent series.
Publication-priority coverage is qualified because a potentially relevant full technical article remained inaccessible.
title: Sharp all-order moment thresholds for Bernoulli-erased two-step deadbeat control
